sources.title: Summit and Peak Firmware Update - Version 2.1 Addendum
sources.applicability: Summit and Peak, with Peak-only sections explicitly identified in the document

policy.aiExposureRule: verificationStatus must be verified, aiExposed must be true, and the entity must be applicable to the target firmware
policy.midiExposureRule: mapping existence, translation, and firmware applicability must all be verified; aiUsable must be true
policy.firmwareRule: Verification status and firmware applicability are independent. Applicability is expressed with introducedInFirmware/removedInFirmware and evaluated against the explicit catalog target.
policy.scopeRule: part, multi and global settings are validated independently
